notes: A synthetic example: a Next.js App Router application with Vitest unit and component tests and a Playwright layer.
Tests ran in a scratch copy made with git archive, with node_modules linked, a fake DATABASE_URL on 127.0.0.1, fake payment keys, and a network guard preloaded with NODE_OPTIONS.
The unit layer was run twice to observe flakiness; these runs are recent execution, not CI history.
Weighted decimals are indicative; differences of a few tenths are not material.

layers.name: e2e
layers.reason: Needs the built app and a Postgres database; no disposable database was available. The specs were read, not run.

failures.test: src/lib/pricing.test.ts > applies the weekend surcharge once
failures.evidence: Expected 54.00, received 59.40 in every run: the surcharge is applied twice
Overlap at the end boundary accepted in every run

failures.test: booking-form and calendar component tests timing out
failures.evidence: Test timed out in 5000ms; fixed waitFor intervals under 16 workers

failures.test: notification and calendar tests failing in one run only
failures.evidence: Passed in r2 with no change: flaky
Passed in r1 and r2; slower instrumented run

applied_caps.explanation: Reliability scored 3: red in both assessed runs from timeouts, with six tests flaky between runs. The cap of 5 lowers the overall from 5.2.

dimensions.name: Test effectiveness
dimensions.finding: Booking and pricing rules have meaningful outcome tests [e1], but two-factor sign-in and refund handlers have none [e2].

evidence.text: Run r1: 1,404 of 1,431 tests passed, including src/lib/pricing.test.ts outcome checks on totals and VAT
Route-to-test mapping: app/api/auth/two-factor/verify/route.ts and app/api/refunds/route.ts are imported by no test

risks: A broken two-factor check or refund calculation would ship green
recommendations: Add handler tests for two-factor verification and refunds, including rejection paths

dimensions.name: Suite trustworthiness
dimensions.finding: Failures are believable when they occur [e1], but every run was red from timeouts, so a red build carries little signal [e2].

evidence.text: The 3 product failures in run r1 reproduce in run r2 with the same assertion messages
Runs r1 and r2 both failed: 19 and 16 failures, 13 of them timeouts in src/components/booking-form.test.tsx
vitest.setup.ts mocks @/lib/db globally, so no unit test exercises a real query

risks: Developers learn to ignore red runs, and a real regression hides among timeouts
recommendations: Fix or quarantine the timing-dependent component tests so a red run means a defect

dimensions.name: Reliability and determinism
dimensions.finding: Red in both assessed runs for non-product reasons: timing-dependent component tests time out under load, and 6 tests failed in only one of the two runs.
evidence: Runs r1 and r2: 13 timeouts in src/components/booking-form.test.tsx and src/components/calendar.test.tsx
execution_result.failures: 6 tests failed in exactly one of two runs
Coverage run r3 raised timeouts from 13 to 21
risks: Real failures are lost among flaky ones
recommendations: Replace fixed waits in component tests with findBy* queries; raise the per-test timeout only where justified

dimensions.name: Test design and level selection
dimensions.finding: Rules are mostly tested at unit level and the end-to-end layer is small, but route handlers are tested in jsdom rather than a Node environment.
evidence: vitest.config.ts sets environment: "jsdom" globally, including app/api/**/route.test.ts
e2e/ holds 9 Playwright specs for booking and sign-in journeys
risks: Server code runs with browser globals it never has in production
recommendations: Use environmentMatchGlobs (or per-file // @vitest-environment node) for route handler tests

dimensions.name: Assertion and oracle quality
dimensions.finding: Most tests assert concrete outcomes; 23 tests have no assertion and 4 swallow errors in try/catch.
evidence: 23 test bodies with no expect() (expect-expect lint)
src/lib/notify.test.ts wraps the call in try { ... } catch {} with no assertion in the catch
risks: Assertion-free tests pass whatever the code does
recommendations: Enable vitest/expect-expect and remove empty catch blocks

dimensions.name: Test scope and coverage
dimensions.finding: Instrumented line coverage is 81.2% [e1]; untested interfaces are concentrated in authentication and refunds [e2].

evidence.text: interface_coverage: 41 of 46 route handlers imported by a test; the 5 untested are listed

risks: Coverage is lowest where the risk is highest
recommendations: Test the five untested handlers before raising coverage elsewhere

dimensions.name: Isolation and state management
dimensions.finding: No test reached the network [e1], but a global database mock means isolation from the real database is never tested either way [e2].

evidence.text: Network guard (NODE_OPTIONS --require net-guard.cjs) logged 0 non-loopback connection attempts across runs r1 to r3
vitest.setup.ts: vi.mock("@/lib/db") applies to every test

risks: Query and transaction defects are invisible to the suite
recommendations: Run repository tests against a disposable Postgres container

dimensions.name: Maintainability and appropriate reuse
dimensions.finding: Tests sit next to the code they test and use small builders; 31 files named *-coverage.test.ts duplicate scenarios from the main test files.
evidence: src/test/builders.ts provides booking and customer builders
31 files match *-coverage.test.ts, e.g. `booking-form-branch-coverage.test.tsx`
risks: Coverage-chasing duplicates double the cost of every behaviour change
recommendations: Fold coverage-named files into the behaviour tests they duplicate

dimensions.name: CI/CD integration
dimensions.finding: CI runs the unit layer on pull requests but never the end-to-end layer, and the coverage thresholds in vitest.config.ts never run because CI omits --coverage.
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs npm test on pull_request; no job runs playwright
vitest.config.ts sets an 80% coverage threshold; ci.yml never passes --coverage
risks: End-to-end regressions and coverage drops are not gated
recommendations: Add a Playwright job with a service database, and run coverage in CI

dimensions.name: Debuggability and reporting
dimensions.finding: Assertion diffs are clear, but CI keeps no JUnit, coverage or Playwright artefacts.
evidence: ci.yml has no upload-artifact step
playwright.config.ts sets trace: "retain-on-failure" (unused in CI)
risks: CI failures must be reproduced locally to diagnose
recommendations: Upload JUnit and coverage reports from CI

dimensions.name: Performance and feedback speed
dimensions.finding: The unit layer takes about nine minutes on 16 workers, and a pre-commit hook runs all of it.
evidence: Runs r1 and r2 took 531 s and 548 s (vitest --reporter=json durations)
.husky/pre-commit runs npm test
risks: Slow feedback encourages skipping the hook
recommendations: Run only related tests in the pre-commit hook (vitest related --run)

dimensions.name: Test data management
dimensions.finding: Builders create synthetic customers and bookings; boundary dates are covered for pricing only.
evidence: src/test/builders.ts
src/lib/pricing.test.ts covers month-end and leap-day bookings
risks: Date edge cases elsewhere are unchecked
recommendations: Add boundary dates to the availability tests

dimensions.name: Environment portability and realism
dimensions.finding: The unit layer runs anywhere with fake environment values [e1], but the npm test script sets TZ=UTC and vitest.setup.ts overrides it [e2].

evidence.text: Runs r1 to r3 used a fake DATABASE_URL on 127.0.0.1 and fake payment keys; no test needed a real service
package.json "test": "TZ=UTC vitest run"; vitest.setup.ts sets process.env.TZ = "Europe/London"

risks: Time-zone-dependent results differ between npm test and npx vitest
recommendations: Set the time zone in one place

dimensions.name: Security, privacy, accessibility, compatibility
dimensions.finding: Authorisation negatives exist for bookings only; two-factor and refund handlers have no tests, and no accessibility checks run.
evidence: app/api/bookings/[id]/route.test.ts checks another customer gets 403
No axe or accessibility assertions in e2e/
risks: Authentication and permission regressions would ship green
recommendations: Add authorisation-negative tests for every handler that reads or changes customer data

dimensions.name: Ownership and operational discipline
dimensions.finding: CODEOWNERS covers the test directories; 7 skipped tests have no ticket or expiry.
evidence: .github/CODEOWNERS lists src/ and e2e/
7 it.skip calls with no linked issue
recommendations: Require an issue link and expiry on every skip

critical_findings.title: Two-factor and refund handlers have no tests
evidence: app/api/auth/two-factor/verify/route.ts: no test imports it or calls /api/auth/two-factor/verify
app/api/refunds/route.ts: no test imports it or calls /api/refunds
critical_findings.impact: A regression in second-factor checks or refund amounts would ship with a green build.

critical_findings.title: The suite is never green
evidence: Runs r1 to r3 all failed; 13 timeouts recur in every run
6 tests failed in only one of two runs
critical_findings.impact: Red no longer means a defect, so the three product failures found in every run go unnoticed.

critical_findings.title: CI does not run the end-to-end layer or the coverage thresholds
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs npm test only
vitest.config.ts thresholds apply only with --coverage
critical_findings.impact: Journey regressions and coverage drops are not gated.

recommendations.title: Make a red run mean a defect
recommendations.action: Fix the 13 timing-dependent component tests (findBy* queries instead of fixed waits), quarantine the 6 flaky ones with an issue and expiry, and fix the 3 product failures.
acceptance_criteria: Two consecutive full unit runs are green
Every quarantined test links an issue with an expiry date

recommendations.title: Test the two-factor and refund handlers
recommendations.action: Add route handler tests for two-factor setup and verification and for refunds, covering success, rejection and permission paths.
acceptance_criteria: interface_coverage lists no untested authentication or refund handler
Each new test fails when the handler's check is removed

recommendations.title: Run the end-to-end layer in CI
recommendations.action: Add a Playwright job with a Postgres service container that runs on pull requests.
acceptance_criteria: The Playwright job is a required check

recommendations.title: Test the database layer against a real database
recommendations.action: Remove the global @/lib/db mock and run repository tests against a disposable Postgres container.
acceptance_criteria: No vi.mock of @/lib/db in setup files
Repository tests run against a container in CI

recommendations.title: Enforce assertions in every test
recommendations.action: Enable the vitest/expect-expect lint rule and remove empty catch blocks in tests.

recommendations.title: Run route handler tests in a Node environment
recommendations.action: Split the Vitest configuration so app/api tests use environment node and component tests use jsdom.
acceptance_criteria: No route handler test runs under jsdom

recommendations.title: Supply CI history and the issue tracker
recommendations.action: Export the last 30 CI runs with durations and retries, and give read access to the bug tracker, so operational health and defect yield can be assessed.
acceptance_criteria: Escaped defects can be compared with the untested interfaces
